log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Can be one of: GETDNS_LOG_EMERG, GETDNS_LOG_ALERT, GETDNS_LOG_CRIT, GETDNS_LOG_ERR, GETDNS_LOG_WARNING, GETDNS_LOG_NOTICE, GETDNS_LOG_INFO, GETDNS_LOG_DEBUG.

resolution_type.description: Specifies whether to run as a recursive or stub resolver. For Stubby this MUST be set to GETDNS_RESOLUTION_STUB.

dns_transport_list_0.description: Transport protocol for DNS queries. Can be GETDNS_TRANSPORT_UDP, GETDNS_TRANSPORT_TCP, or GETDNS_TRANSPORT_TLS.

tls_authentication.description: TLS authentication mode. GETDNS_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED for Strict mode, GETDNS_AUTHENTICATION_NONE for Opportunistic mode.

tls_query_padding_blocksize.description: EDNS0 option to pad the size of the DNS query to the given blocksize.

edns_client_subnet_private.description: EDNS0 option for ECS client privacy. 1 enables private mode, 0 disables it.

round_robin_upstreams.description: Set to 1 to distribute queries across all available name servers, 0 to use them as an ordered list.

idle_timeout.description: EDNS0 option for keepalive idle timeout in milliseconds.

listen_address_ipv4.description: IPv4 listen address for the stubby daemon.

listen_address_ipv6.description: IPv6 listen address for the stubby daemon. Note: cannot start with `::` in this config format, use `::0`.

upstream_ipv4_default_ip.description: IPv4 address of the default upstream recursive server.

upstream_ipv4_default_auth_name.description: Authentication domain name for the default IPv4 upstream.

upstream_ipv4_default_pin.description: Base64 encoded SPKI pin for the default IPv4 upstream.

upstream_ipv6_default_ip.description: IPv6 address of the default upstream recursive server.

upstream_ipv6_default_auth_name.description: Authentication domain name for the default IPv6 upstream.

upstream_ipv6_default_pin.description: Base64 encoded SPKI pin for the default IPv6 upstream.
